extraction: Claude DevFleet: orchestrate multi-agent coding tasks via external DevFleet server (github.com/LEC-AI/claude-devfleet) connected via MCP. Each agent runs in isolated git worktree with full tooling. Flow: plan_project(prompt) -> project_id + mission DAG -> show plan -> get approval -> dispatch_mission(M1) -> Agent 1 spawns in worktree -> M1 completes -> auto-merge -> auto-dispatch M2 (depends_on M1) -> M2 completes -> auto-merge -> get_report(M2) -> files_changed, what_done, errors, next_steps. Tools: plan_project, create_project, create_mission (with depends_on list and auto_dispatch), dispatch_mission, cancel_mission, wait_for_mission, get_mission_status, get_report, get_dashboard, list_projects, list_missions. Default 3 concurrent agents (configurable via DEVFLEET_MAX_AGENTS). Missions with auto_dispatch=true queue when slots full and dispatch automatically as slots free. Guidelines: confirm plan before dispatching, include mission titles/IDs in status, read report before retrying failed mission, check dashboard for slot availability, DAG dependencies no cycles, isolated worktrees auto-merge on completion.
